prompt: Rendering a list of 100 posts runs 101 queries: one for the posts and one per post for its author.
tells: one per post for its author
why: Eager-load authors in one query (JOIN or WHERE id IN).
trap: Each query is fast; there are just too many.

prompt: A GraphQL query for 50 orders triggers 50 separate customer lookups from field resolvers.
why: Batch with a DataLoader so lookups combine into one query.
trap: GraphQL makes N+1 easy to write.

prompt: An API endpoint is fast in tests with 3 items and slow in production with 500. Logs show a query inside the serializer for each item.
tells: a query inside the serializer for each item
trap: The scale difference hides it in tests.

prompt: A service calls the pricing API once per cart line, so big carts take seconds.
why: Use a batch endpoint that prices all lines in one call.
trap: N+1 isn't only a database problem.
